models.name: mall_platform_customers
models.description:
Registered customer accounts with email and password credentials and account status for login control.

This table is the authentication root for customer shoppers in the marketplace. It stores the unique sign-in identity, credential hash, and account lifecycle state used to control access to customer features.

Customer-specific session, password reset, and profile data are managed in separate tables owned by other components, so this model remains focused on authentication and account status only.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key for the customer account.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Unique email address used for customer login and account identification.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Hashed password used to authenticate the customer account.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current account state for login control, such as active, banned, or deleted.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the customer account was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the customer account was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the customer account was soft-deleted, if applicable.

models.name: mall_platform_customer_sessions
models.description:
Stores authentication sessions for customer accounts. Each row represents one login session used to validate customer access and support logout behavior.

The table is append-only from a business perspective and records the client context for each session together with its creation and expiration timestamps. Each session belongs to exactly one {@link mall_platform_customers} record.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary Key.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address observed when the session was created.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Request URL or entry page associated with the session creation.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer URL recorded when the session was created.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session was created.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session expires and becomes invalid.

models.name: mall_platform_customer_password_resets
models.description:
Stores password reset tokens for customer account recovery.

Each record belongs to exactly one customer account and represents a time-bound recovery token used to verify password reset requests. The table supports secure lookup, expiration handling, and auditability for account recovery flows while keeping all relationships child-to-parent only.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key for the customer password reset record.

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Opaque password reset token used to verify the recovery request.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Time when the password reset token expires and can no longer be used.

plainFields.name: used_at
plainFields.description: Time when the reset token was consumed, if it has already been used.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the password reset record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the password reset record was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp for logical removal of the recovery record.

models.name: mall_platform_sellers
models.description:
Registered seller accounts used for authentication, account lifecycle control, and platform moderation. This table stores the seller's login credentials and account status only; public shop presentation data, approval workflows, sessions, and password resets are handled by separate tables in other components.

The record is the authoritative identity for a seller actor and supports login, approval visibility, rejection handling, suspension, and deletion controls without duplicating profile or request history data.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key for the seller account.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Unique email address used for seller sign-in.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Hashed password used to authenticate the seller account.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current account state for seller login and moderation control, such as pending, approved, rejected, suspended, or banned.

plainFields.name: rejection_reason
plainFields.description: Reason provided when the seller registration is rejected. Null unless the account is in a rejected state.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the seller account was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the seller account was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the seller account was soft-deleted. Null when the account is active.

models.name: mall_platform_seller_sessions
models.description:
Stores login sessions for seller accounts so authenticated merchants can remain signed in and safely log out.

Each session belongs to exactly one seller account and records the network context at creation time together with an expiration timestamp for security enforcement. This table is append-only and supports session validation, revocation, and cleanup without storing any business data beyond authentication state.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key for the seller session record.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address captured when the session was created.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Current page or request URL associated with the session creation context.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer URL captured at the time the session was created.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session was created.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session expires and can no longer be used.

models.name: mall_platform_seller_password_resets
models.description:
Stores password reset tokens issued for seller account recovery. Each record belongs to exactly one seller account and tracks the token lifecycle so a seller can safely complete password reset within the allowed time window.

The table is append-only from an auditing perspective, with one-time-use reset tokens, expiration control, and standard temporal fields for record management.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key for the seller password reset record.

plainFields.name: reset_token
plainFields.description: Secure token used to authenticate the seller password reset request.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Time when the reset token becomes invalid.

plainFields.name: consumed_at
plainFields.description: Time when the reset token was successfully used to reset the password, if already consumed.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Time when this reset token record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Time when this reset token record was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp for the reset token record, if it was invalidated or removed from active use.

models.name: mall_platform_administrators
models.description:
Privileged administrator accounts used for sign-in and platform-wide access control. This table stores the administrator's authentication credentials, authorization grade, and account status while leaving sessions and password recovery to separate child tables. It is the authoritative {@link mall_platform_administrators} record for admin identity and permission level.

Administrators may be regular or super administrators, and the account status determines whether sign-in is allowed. The table is intentionally compact so that audit history, sessions, and recovery flows remain normalized in dedicated tables.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key for the administrator account.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Unique email address used for administrator sign-in and account identification.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Hashed password used to authenticate the administrator account.

plainFields.name: grade
plainFields.description: Administrator authorization level. Supported values are regular administrator and super administrator.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Login and account state for the administrator account, such as active, suspended, or banned.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the administrator account was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the administrator account was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the administrator account was soft-deleted, if applicable.

models.name: mall_platform_administrator_sessions
models.description:
Stores authenticated administrator login sessions for access control and logout management. Each record represents one session token issued to a single {@link mall_platform_administrators} account and is used to validate active access, track session provenance, and support secure expiration.

This table follows the standard session lifecycle pattern for actor accounts. It is append-only in practice, with one row per session and an expiration timestamp used to invalidate access after the session window ends.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary Key.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address captured when the session was created.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Request URL or origin reference associated with session creation.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer URL associated with session creation.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session was created.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session becomes invalid.

models.name: mall_platform_administrator_password_resets
models.description:
Stores password reset tokens and expiration metadata for {@link mall_platform_administrators} account recovery.

Each record represents one administrator password reset request and is used to validate a reset action before a new password is issued. The table keeps only the token and its lifecycle timestamps, with a foreign key back to the owning administrator account.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key for the administrator password reset request.

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Secure password reset token used to verify the recovery request.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Time when the reset token becomes invalid.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this reset request was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this reset request was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp for invalidated reset requests.

models.name: mall_platform_customer_profiles
models.description:
Stores the editable customer-facing identity details for one customer account, including display name and phone number.

Each profile belongs to exactly one {@link mall_platform_customers} record and is deleted when the owning customer account is removed. The table contains only atomic profile attributes and standard temporal audit columns so customer identity details remain normalized and easy to maintain.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary Key.

plainFields.name: display_name
plainFields.description: Customer-visible display name used on the account profile.

plainFields.name: phone_number
plainFields.description: Customer contact phone number shown and edited in the profile.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp for profile removal.

models.name: mall_platform_shipping_addresses
models.description:
Stores saved shipping addresses for customer accounts, including recipient and location details, with support for a single default address per customer.

Each row belongs to exactly one customer account and represents an atomic shipping destination that can be selected during checkout. The table keeps the address data normalized into separate fields so customer profiles, orders, and checkout flows can reference a stable address record without embedding denormalized location blobs.

The default-address marker is used to help customers choose their primary shipping destination while preserving the full history of saved addresses through soft deletion and timestamps.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary Key.

plainFields.name: recipient_name
plainFields.description: Recipient name used for delivery labeling.

plainFields.name: phone_number
plainFields.description: Recipient phone number for delivery contact.

plainFields.name: street_address
plainFields.description: Street address line for the shipping destination.

plainFields.name: city
plainFields.description: City or locality for the shipping destination.

plainFields.name: state_province
plainFields.description: State, province, or region for the shipping destination.

plainFields.name: postal_code
plainFields.description: Postal or ZIP code for the shipping destination.

plainFields.name: country
plainFields.description: Country for the shipping destination.

plainFields.name: is_default
plainFields.description: True when this address is the customer's default shipping address.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp.

models.name: mall_platform_seller_accounts
models.description:
Merchant account record used for seller sign-in, approval tracking, and seller account lifecycle management.

This table stores the seller's login identity and platform-controlled lifecycle state, including approval outcome, suspension, and deletion status. It is the owner table for the seller account boundary and supports seller access control while related shop presentation data is maintained in {@link mall_platform_seller_profiles}.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key for the seller account.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Unique email address used for seller login identity.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Hashed password used for seller authentication.

plainFields.name: approval_status
plainFields.description: Current seller approval state such as pending, approved, or rejected.

plainFields.name: rejection_reason
plainFields.description: Reason provided when a seller approval request is rejected.

plainFields.name: suspended_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the seller account was suspended, if applicable.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the seller account was soft-deleted, if applicable.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the seller account record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the seller account record was last updated.

models.name: mall_platform_seller_profiles
models.description:
Public shop profile information for one seller account, including the shop name, shop description, and logo image reference shown to customers.

This table stores only the live profile state owned by {@link mall_platform_seller_accounts}. Historical edits are preserved in the separate seller profile snapshot table owned by another component, so this model remains focused on the current public-facing profile record.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key for the seller profile record.

plainFields.name: shop_name
plainFields.description: Public shop name displayed to customers.

plainFields.name: shop_description
plainFields.description: Public shop description displayed on the seller profile page.

plainFields.name: logo_image_uri
plainFields.description: URI of the current shop logo image shown to customers.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the seller profile record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the seller profile record was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the seller profile record was soft deleted, if applicable.

models.name: mall_platform_products
models.description:
Canonical sellable product records for the marketplace catalog, including seller ownership, category assignment, product identity, description, and base pricing for browsing and search.

This table represents the root product entity only. Product images, product variants, inventory history, and snapshots are managed in separate tables owned by other components, so this model stores only the product-level references needed for catalog operations and historical reconstruction through related entities.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Product display name used in listings and detail pages.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Product description shown to customers on the detail page.

plainFields.name: base_price
plainFields.description: Product base price used when variants do not override pricing and for catalog price presentation.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the product was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the product was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the product was soft-deleted; null when active.

models.name: mall_platform_product_images
models.description:
Stores ordered presentation images for a product, including the main thumbnail image used in listings and the customer-facing gallery order.

Each row belongs to exactly one product and represents a single uploaded image. The table keeps image positioning separate from the product record so products can have multiple images while preserving a deterministic display order. Historical audit and snapshot preservation are handled by a different table owned outside this generation task.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key.

plainFields.name: image_url
plainFields.description: Public or storage URL for the product image.

plainFields.name: sort_order
plainFields.description: Display order of the image within the product gallery, starting from the main thumbnail.

plainFields.name: is_main
plainFields.description: Whether this image is the product's primary thumbnail image.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the image record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the image record was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the image record was soft deleted, if applicable.

models.name: mall_platform_product_variants
models.description:
Stores purchasable SKU variants for a product, including SKU code, option combination, optional price override, and availability state.

Each record belongs to one product and represents one sellable configuration such as a color and size combination. The table supports product browsing, cart selection, checkout, and seller-side management of variant identity and pricing, while historical changes are preserved in separate snapshot tables owned by another component.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key.

plainFields.name: sku_code
plainFields.description: Unique seller-defined stock keeping unit code for this variant.

plainFields.name: option_values
plainFields.description: Human-readable option combination for the variant, such as color and size labels.

plainFields.name: price_override
plainFields.description: Optional variant-specific selling price that overrides the product base price when present.

plainFields.name: is_active
plainFields.description: Indicates whether the variant is currently available for sale and listing.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the variant was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the variant was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the variant was soft deleted, if applicable.

models.name: mall_platform_product_image_snapshots
models.description: Immutable history records for product image changes, preserving prior image state for audit and historical reconstruction. Each row captures the state of a product image at a point in time so product presentation can be reviewed after edits or deletion.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key for the product image snapshot record.

plainFields.name: image_url
plainFields.description: Snapshot of the product image URL at the time the change was recorded.

plainFields.name: image_order
plainFields.description: Snapshot of the display order used for the product image at the time the change was recorded.

plainFields.name: is_main
plainFields.description: Snapshot of whether the image was the main thumbnail at the time the change was recorded.

plainFields.name: changed_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the product image state was captured in this snapshot.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp, if the snapshot record is ever marked as deleted for system maintenance.

models.name: mall_platform_product_variant_snapshots
models.description:
Immutable point-in-time records of {@link mall_platform_product_variants} edits. This table preserves the historical state of a product variant so SKU changes, option updates, and price revisions can be reviewed later for audit and dispute resolution.

Each row captures the snapshot's own version of the variant state at the time the change was recorded. It links back to the live variant and its parent product for traceability, while remaining append-only and never being deleted.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary Key.

plainFields.name: sku_code
plainFields.description: Snapshot copy of the variant SKU code at the time the change was recorded.

plainFields.name: option_summary
plainFields.description: Snapshot copy of the variant option combination in a stable human-readable form.

plainFields.name: price_override
plainFields.description: Snapshot copy of the variant-specific price override, if any, at the time the change was recorded.

plainFields.name: snapshot_reason
plainFields.description: Reason or context for the variant change that triggered this snapshot.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this snapshot record was created.

models.name: mall_platform_product_variant_snapshot_options
models.description: Stores one atomic option-value pair for a specific product variant snapshot. Each row preserves a single structured option entry, such as color or size, so variant snapshot state remains fully normalized and can be reconstructed without using JSON or array fields. The table belongs to {@link mall_platform_product_variant_snapshots} and supports historical reconstruction of variant configuration at the time of the snapshot.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary Key.

plainFields.name: option_key
plainFields.description: Atomic option name within the variant snapshot, such as color or size.

plainFields.name: option_value
plainFields.description: Atomic option value within the variant snapshot, such as red or large.

models.name: mall_platform_inventory_records
models.description: Append-only stock movement history for a single product variant. Each record captures one inventory change event, the quantity delta, the business reason for the movement, and when it occurred so current stock can be derived from the full history. This table is immutable in practice and supports restocking, manual adjustments, order deductions, and stock restoration events through {@link mall_platform_product_variants}.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key for the inventory movement record.

plainFields.name: quantity_change
plainFields.description: Signed quantity delta for this stock movement event; positive values increase stock and negative values decrease stock.

plainFields.name: reason
plainFields.description: Business explanation for the inventory movement, such as restock, order deduction, cancellation restore, refund restore, or manual adjustment.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this inventory movement was recorded.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this record was last updated by the system before being treated as immutable.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp, if ever used for administrative archival of invalid records.

models.name: mall_platform_shopping_carts
models.description:
Customer-owned shopping cart header that groups cart lines and stores checkout-preparation state for one customer account. The cart contains only header-level ownership and lifecycle data; individual selected variants, quantities, and line calculations are stored in {@link mall_platform_cart_items}.

This table supports the active cart experience before checkout, including one-cart-per-customer integrity and lifecycle tracking across updates and soft deletion.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary Key.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: When the cart record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: When the cart record was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: When the cart was soft-deleted, if applicable.

models.name: mall_platform_cart_items
models.description:
Stores one selected product variant line inside a customer shopping cart.

Each row represents a single cart entry with its parent cart, chosen product variant, quantity, and current availability state used during checkout validation. The table remains normalized by storing only line-level facts; pricing totals are derived at query time, and the parent cart plus referenced product variant provide the broader purchase context.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key for the shopping cart item.

plainFields.name: quantity
plainFields.description: Number of units of the selected product variant stored in this cart line.

plainFields.name: availability_state
plainFields.description: Current cart-line availability marker used to indicate whether the referenced variant is available, out of stock, or otherwise unavailable for checkout.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the cart item was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the cart item was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the cart item was soft deleted, if applicable.

models.name: mall_platform_wishlists
models.description:
Stores one wishlist container for each customer account. The record represents the saved-products collection owned by a customer and serves as the parent entity for wishlist item rows managed in the separate wishlist item table.

This table intentionally contains only the ownership and lifecycle metadata required to support paginated wishlist browsing, while the individual saved products remain normalized in {@link mall_platform_wishlist_items}.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary Key.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the wishlist record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the wishlist record was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the wishlist record was soft deleted, if applicable.

models.name: mall_platform_wishlist_items
models.description:
Stores one saved product entry within a customer wishlist. Each row links exactly one wishlist to exactly one product, with no variant-specific data, so customers can save products for later and the item can be removed automatically when the product is deleted.

This table is a pure junction-style business entity that supports wishlist browsing and item removal while keeping product details normalized in {@link mall_platform_products}.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary Key.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this wishlist item was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this wishlist item was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this wishlist item was soft deleted, if applicable.

models.name: mall_platform_orders
models.description:
Stores one checkout result per customer, including the overall order identity, status, totals, and preserved shipping destination for the purchase.

This table represents the order header created after successful checkout. It preserves the customer-owned purchase record and the shipping destination that was selected at purchase time so historical orders remain readable even if the customer later edits or deletes addresses. Item-level purchase details, shipments, and snapshots are maintained in their own component tables.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary Key.

plainFields.name: order_number
plainFields.description: Human-readable order number shown to the customer and support staff.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Derived overall order status for history and browsing, such as paid, shipped, delivered, cancelled, refunded, or partially completed.

plainFields.name: total_amount
plainFields.description: Total order amount at the time of checkout, including all purchased items.

plainFields.name: recipient_name
plainFields.description: Preserved shipping recipient name captured at checkout.

plainFields.name: recipient_phone
plainFields.description: Preserved shipping recipient phone number captured at checkout.

plainFields.name: street_address
plainFields.description: Preserved street address used for shipment destination.

plainFields.name: city
plainFields.description: Preserved city used for shipment destination.

plainFields.name: state_province
plainFields.description: Preserved state or province used for shipment destination.

plainFields.name: postal_code
plainFields.description: Preserved postal code used for shipment destination.

plainFields.name: country
plainFields.description: Preserved country used for shipment destination.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the order was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the order was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft-delete timestamp for retained historical order visibility, when applicable.

models.name: mall_platform_order_items
models.description:
Stores each purchased product variant line within an order, including quantity, item status, and the preserved relational references needed to reconstruct the purchase context.

Each row belongs to exactly one order and exactly one product variant, and records the seller responsible for the item. The live table keeps the operational order-item state, while immutable historical snapshots are maintained in the dedicated snapshot table handled by the snapshots component.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary Key.

plainFields.name: quantity
plainFields.description: Number of units purchased for this order item.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current fulfillment status of the order item, such as paid, shipped, delivered, cancelled, or refunded.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this order item row was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this order item row was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this order item row was soft deleted, if applicable.

models.name: mall_platform_shipments
models.description:
Seller-specific delivery packages that group one or more order items from the same seller and store the shared carrier and tracking information for those items.

A shipment represents a fulfillment unit created during delivery processing. It keeps the shipping metadata at the package level, while item membership is stored in the separate shipment-item junction table. This design supports shared tracking, package-level delivery confirmation, and history preservation for dispute resolution.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key.

plainFields.name: carrier_name
plainFields.description: Shipping carrier name used for this shipment.

plainFields.name: tracking_number
plainFields.description: Carrier tracking number for the shipment.

plainFields.name: tracking_url
plainFields.description: Optional carrier tracking URL for customer visibility.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current shipment status such as preparing, shipped, delivered, or cancelled.

plainFields.name: shipped_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the shipment was handed to the carrier.

plainFields.name: delivered_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the shipment was confirmed delivered.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the shipment record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the shipment record was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp for shipment records that are logically removed.

models.name: mall_platform_shipment_items
models.description:
Associates purchased order items with a shipment so each seller-specific package can contain one or more eligible items.

This table is the junction between {@link mall_platform_shipments} and {@link mall_platform_order_items}. It stores only the assignment relationship and standard temporal fields, while shipment carrier and tracking data remain on the shipment header. The relationship supports grouping multiple order items into a single package without duplicating order or shipping details.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary Key.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the shipment-item assignment was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the shipment-item assignment was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at

models.name: mall_platform_cancellation_requests
models.description:
Stores cancellation requests submitted for a single order item, including the requester’s reason, current review state, and reviewer outcome.

Each request belongs to exactly one order item and records the state needed for seller or administrator review. Immutable history is handled by a separate snapshot table, which is managed in another component and is not recreated here.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key.

foreignFields.name: reviewer_id
foreignFields.description: Reviewer account's {@link mall_platform_administrators.id} or {@link mall_platform_sellers.id}, depending on the actor who handled the request.

plainFields.name: reason
plainFields.description: Customer-provided explanation for requesting cancellation.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current request state such as pending, approved, or rejected.

plainFields.name: reviewed_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the request was reviewed.

plainFields.name: review_result

plainFields.name: updated_at

plainFields.name: deleted_at

models.name: mall_platform_cancellation_request_snapshots
models.description:
Immutable audit snapshots for {@link mall_platform_cancellation_requests} that preserve cancellation request state changes for dispute review and historical reconstruction.

Each row captures a point-in-time representation of the request after a meaningful change, including the preserved status, reviewer outcome, reason text, and audit context needed to understand what changed and when. These records are append-only and are not intended to be edited or deleted in normal operation.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this immutable snapshot record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this snapshot row was last updated in storage, if ever required by infrastructure.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete marker. Snapshot rows are normally retained permanently and this value should remain null.

models.name: mall_platform_refund_requests
models.description:
Current refund requests submitted for a specific delivered order item, including the request reason, current review status, and reviewer outcome metadata.

Each record represents one refund workflow for one purchased order item. The live table stores the current operational state only; immutable before-and-after change history is preserved in the separate refund request snapshot table. This table supports customer submission, seller or administrator review, and dispute-oriented lookup by the owning parties.

plainFields.name: deleted_at

models.name: mall_platform_refund_request_snapshots
models.description:
Immutable snapshot records for refund request changes. Each row preserves the refund request state at a specific moment so approvals, rejections, and other lifecycle updates can be reviewed later for audit and dispute resolution.

This table belongs to {@link mall_platform_refund_requests} and stores historical state only. It is append-only and should not be updated or deleted after creation.

plainFields.name: reviewer_note

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this immutable snapshot record was created.

models.name: mall_platform_reviews
models.description:
Stores the current active customer review for a purchased product. Each review belongs to one customer account and one purchased order item, and it is displayed on the product detail page while preserving only the live review state in this table.

The table keeps the active rating, optional written content, and deletion state for customer-authored feedback. Historical edits and moderation history are preserved in {@link mall_platform_review_snapshots}, which is managed separately.

plainFields.name: updated_at

plainFields.name: deleted_at

models.name: mall_platform_review_snapshots
models.description: Immutable point-in-time snapshots of customer reviews for audit, edit history, deletion preservation, and dispute resolution. Each row captures the review state as it existed when a change occurred, including the review content, rating, and moderation state, while preserving the relationship to the source {@link mall_platform_reviews} and the owning {@link mall_platform_customers}.

plainFields.name: created_at

models.name: mall_platform_product_snapshots

Immutable history records for product changes, preserving prior product state for audit and dispute resolution.

Each row captures a point-in-time product state before or after an edit, so the platform can reconstruct what customers and administrators saw at that moment.
